<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex2702_2024-09-1114-42-58" status="reviewed" ana="corpusmd:colophon"><milestone n="Colophon (217b4-7) (p. 624:4-5)"/>
theg mchog zab mo'i dgongs don rnam 'byed pa'i || tshul 'di <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:4593">bla ma dam pa</rs>s rjes bzung zhing || <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:4593">blo ldan slob ma</rs>s yang yang<anchor xml:id="a1"/><note type="editorial">The second "yang" is not very clear in the manuscript. Its reading comes from the printed version (ID:7391)</note> <lb n="217b5"/> bskul ba'i mthus|| <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4128">blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal</rs> gyis rnam par sbyar || <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:7338">'phags pa'i gsung</rs> dang <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:7338">dam pa'i legs bshad</rs> dpang byas nas || tshig don ma lus gsal bar bshad yod<anchor xml:id="a2"/> de lta na'ang|| <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:4128">bdag</rs> <choice><sic>bla'i</sic>
<corr>blo'i</corr></choice><anchor xml:id="a3"/> nyes pas gal te 'khrul <lb n="217b6"/> pa'i cha mchis na || de nyid gzigs pa'i mkhas pa rnams la bzod par gsol || phyogs zhen phrag dog <choice><sic>ti °</sic><corr>gti</corr></choice><anchor xml:id="a4"/> mug gis bsgribs <anchor xml:id="a5"/> pa'i || log sred can dag 'di yis mchu<anchor xml:id="a6"/> dka' mod || gzu bor gnas shing <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:7338">legs bshad</rs> <lb n="217b7"/> don gnyer ba'i || blo ldan skal ba <anchor xml:id="a7"/> can rnams dgyes par mdzod || <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:4128">bdag</rs> blo dang ba'i mkha' las 'ongs pa'i <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:4660">legs bshad</rs> nyin mor byed pa'i 'od || ma lus 'gro ba'i gling la shar bas mi shes mun pa'i tshogs bcom nas || </seg></TEI>
